title: ask_user result
description: Content of the tool message the SPA sends back for `ask_user` (JSON-encoded). `dismissed` is kept for completeness only: when the user types in the composer instead of answering, the SPA does NOT send a dismissed tool result (MAF would overwrite it); it sends only the user message, optionally prefixed with `[dismissed question q1]`, and the server injects a synthetic skipped result.

status.description: answered: at least one question answered; skipped: user skipped all; dismissed: see schema description.

questionId.description: The `id` of the question that was answered.

selected.description: Labels of the selected options (empty when only free text was given or skipped).

skipped.description: True when the user skipped this question; record it as an open question.
